sloka: मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशो बभौ दीप्तानलप्रभः ।अग्रतो व्यवतस्थे च सीताया वानरोत्तमः ।। ५.३७.३५।।।।
transliteration: merumandarasaṅkāśo babhau dīptānalaprabhaḥ ।agrato vyavatasthe ca sītāyā vānarottamaḥ ।। 5.37.35।।।।

translations.english: The wise bull among monkeys, jumped down from the tree and started growing in size in order to instil confidence in Sita.
